data.short_description: Wonder is preparing to open a new food hall location in Woodbridge, VA at 13257 Worth Avenue in Smoketown Station. The company website states it will be customer ready at some point in August, though a precise opening date is not yet available.

Lindsey's Sandwich Shop is set to open at the former Frostings Bake Shop storefront at 4336 Pouncey Tract Road. Both the outgoing and incoming concepts come from Lindsey Food Group, with owners Mike Lindsey and Kim Love-Lindsey crafting a range of sandwiches. No opening timeline has been confirmed.
Frostings Bake Shop has closed at its 4336 Pouncey Tract Road storefront. The space will be taken over by Lindsey's Sandwich Shop, a new concept from the same Lindsey Food Group ownership.

Denver-based STK Steakhouse is taking over the vacant former Kona Grill space at 1 E. Pratt Street in Baltimore's Inner Harbor. A definitive opening timeline is not yet available; submitted city permits indicate the restaurant hopes to have signage installed before the end of 2026, suggesting customer-ready by early 2027.

Kona Grill ceased operations at 1 E. Pratt Street in Baltimore's Inner Harbor last winter, leaving the restaurant space vacant. STK Steakhouse, also owned by The One Group, will be taking over the location.

Jack's Family Restaurant has received a permit from the Mississippi Department of Health to open in Flora at 130 Edwards Circle. It is not yet clear when the restaurant will be ready, and the Flora location is not yet listed on the Jack's website.

El Agave Mexican Grill + Bar is opening at 5007 Black Road in Memphis and has begun recruiting staff. No official opening date has been announced, though the restaurant's social media activity has increased and it confirmed it is "coming soon."

data.status: aiming to open the weekend of July 17
data.short_description: Aplós Simple Mediterranean is preparing to launch its third location at 803 Sisk Avenue in Oxford, following existing locations in Jackson and Ridgeland. Founder Chef Alex Eaton stated he is aiming to open the weekend of July 17, "assuming we stay on schedule with the final construction and inspections."

data.status: currently on track to open this fall
data.short_description: Shivers Creek Catfish House is opening its fourth location at 422 E. Capitol Street in Jackson, MS, with work currently underway. The restaurant is on track to open this fall, though a precise opening date is not yet available.

P. Terry's has transitioned to an Employee Ownership Trust and announced plans to add more locations in San Antonio, where it currently operates five restaurants. No specific sites or opening timelines have been announced.

Emmer & Rye Hospitality Group has been selected to lead the food and beverage program at the restored Sítio El Tropicano hotel in San Antonio's River Walk. Plans include a lobby café and provisions shop, a signature all-day restaurant, and a poolside venue; no opening timeline has been announced.

Canadian chain JOEY Restaurants is opening its first Massachusetts location at 250 Northern Avenue in Boston's Seaport, taking over the former Tony C's and Temazcal space. No opening date has been announced; a business filing for JOEY Restaurant (Seaport) Inc. confirms the upcoming opening.

The team behind Dotty's Kitchen & Raw Bar has announced plans to open an on-site coffee shop called Daybreak Coffee & Provisions at 1250 Hancock Street in Quincy. No official menu or opening date has yet been announced; the owners are currently hiring baristas.

Ember & Iron from Chef Michael and Brittany Cooney is opening a new location at 62 Spanish Street in the St. Augustine Historic District. The restaurant will serve its full menu plus a seafood program influenced by the Cooneys' other restaurant, Gemma Fish + Oyster.

A Five Guys franchise group (Rockham 5G) is awaiting construction permits for a new location at 3220 Saint Paul Street in Baltimore's Charles Village, taking over the former Trek Bicycle space. The group is hoping to have the location open before the year is out.

data.status: plan review paperwork has been submitted
data.short_description: The Tot Spot Jax food truck, which went dark on social media and its website after May 6, appears to be relaunching after plan review paperwork was submitted by The Tot Spot Jax Inc. No details on a relaunch date have been revealed.

Plan review paperwork has been submitted by Renee Willard for a new food truck called "Willard BBQ," potentially reviving the former Willard's Bar-B-Q Junction which closed in February 2022 after 30 years. Details on the new food truck have yet to be revealed.

Willard's Bar-B-Q Junction closed in February 2022 after 30 years of operation at 4610 San Juan Ave in Jacksonville. The closing was attributed to challenges from COVID-19, including scarce product, rising costs, and labor issues.

data.location: FL-16 & Co Rd 208, St. Johns, FL 32092
data.short_description: A new 7 Brew Coffee drive-thru location has been proposed at FL-16 and County Road 208 in St. Johns County, FL. Plans submitted to the county call for a 510-square-foot building with two drive-thru lanes and 20 parking spaces.

data.location: Near intersection of International Golf Parkway and Village Commons Drive, St. Johns, FL
data.short_description: An additional 7 Brew Coffee location is planned near the intersection of International Golf Parkway and Village Commons Drive in St. Johns County, FL. No further details beyond the location have been provided.

data.status: temporarily closed; last day for dining was June 14
data.short_description: The Quonset hut restaurant at Congaree and Penn farm closed temporarily on June 14 for a renovation that will transform it into a fully enclosed, temperature-controlled restaurant called "High Horse," expected to open this winter. During the closure, the farm launched The Roost, a new open-air outdoor restaurant, on June 19.

Congaree and Penn launched The Roost, a new casual open-air restaurant, on June 19 as a temporary dining option during the renovation of its Quonset hut. The Roost features a seasonal all-day menu with farm-to-table dishes.

data.status: working toward the goal of a late-September launch
data.short_description: Bebos Cajun Kitchen is opening at 117 E Lake Ave, Suite 101 in Downtown Auburndale, FL, according to recently submitted plan review documents. No official opening date has been set, but owner Phillip Robinson says the restaurant is working toward a late-September launch.

data.status: expected to open in late summer 2026
data.short_description: Ron's Gourmet Ice Cream is expanding with a third location at 305 Washington Street in Westwood's Islington neighborhood, taking over the former Juicygreens space. The new location is expected to open in late summer 2026.
Juicygreens closed at the 305 Washington Street space in Westwood on June 30. The health-focused eatery continues to operate seven locations across Greater Boston.

Red Mesa Cantina closed suddenly in early June 2026 at 128 Third St. S in downtown St. Pete after a 16-year run. News of the closing came suddenly, leaving the three-story space's future unclear until a replacement was announced.

data.status: expected to start opening in early 2027
data.short_description: The team behind Rreal Tacos is developing a new multi-concept restaurant at the former Red Mesa Cantina space at 128 Third St. S in downtown St. Pete. The specific concepts have not yet been revealed; they are expected to start opening in early 2027 and launch in phases, representing an eight-figure investment and more than 800 total seats.

Calle Bistro is a new restaurant opening at 1544 Main St in Downtown Sarasota. The concept offers brunch, dinner, cocktails, and late-night vibes with live DJs by night. An opening date has not been announced.

data.store_name: Frozen in Time Gourmet Ice Cream
data.location: 7810 US Hwy 19, Unit A, Port Richey, FL 34668
data.short_description: A new Frozen in Time Gourmet Ice Cream location is in the works at 7810 US Hwy 19, Unit A in Port Richey, per submitted plan review documents. The brand already operates a scoop shop in Crystal River and a food truck. An official opening date has not been announced.

The team behind Spoke Wine Bar is preparing to launch Liars Restaurant in the former True Bistro space at 1153 Broadway in Teele Square, Somerville. No opening timeline has been announced. The restaurant is described as the "bigger baby sister" to Spoke Wine Bar.

data.store_name: MAX Ultimate Food Café (at Smith Family Pavilion)
data.short_description: Dorchester-based catering company MAX Ultimate Food was selected to operate an all-day café at the $24 million Charlesbank and Smith Family Pavilion, expected to open this fall near the Museum of Science. The café will offer breakfast and lunch fare including coffee, espresso, pastries, and seasonal items. The pavilion is funded entirely through private donations.

Gastronaut is a pan-Russia cocktail bar and small plates concept set to open this fall at 72 MacDougal St in the West Village, taking over the former Parcelle wine bar space. The bar program will highlight international vodkas led by the team behind El Copitas in St. Petersburg. The menu blends Eastern European flavors with Japanese and East Asian presentations.

data.location: 417 S. Rosemary Avenue, West Palm Beach, FL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: BuddhaBerry Yogurt Holdings LLC filed permit applications to open a BuddhaBerry at CityPlace, 417 S. Rosemary Avenue in West Palm Beach. This will be the brand's third location and first outside New York. No official opening date has been set beyond a fall 2026 announcement on Instagram.

Joystick Gamebar announced its Edgewood location will close with a final day of service on July 12. The owner did not provide a specific reason but expressed hopes to reopen at a new location. The retro arcade bar has operated in the neighborhood for 14 years.

data.location: 2400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Breakwater Hospitality Group has been selected to negotiate an agreement with the City of West Palm Beach to develop Sea Salt Beach House at Currie Park as part of a $35 million waterfront redevelopment. The approximately 378-seat concept is described as a modern waterfront destination with indoor dining, covered terraces, and open-air seating. No timeline has been established.

data.location: 2101 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702
data.short_description: Taqueria Chapala confirmed its East Cesar Chavez Street location will close in September 2026 due to a lease renewal dispute with property owners. The family-owned Mexican restaurant has been part of the Austin dining scene for nearly three decades. Two other Taqueria Chapala locations in the Austin area will continue operating.

Lucca, an international Italian restaurant chain operated by CM Food Co., officially opened its first Florida location at Doral Commons on July 3. The restaurant serves house-made Italian dishes, pizzas, pastas, and desserts. Lucca already has locations in Aruba, Panama, and Venezuela.

Cloud Nine Miami, LLC filed permit applications to open Yoghurt & Yoga at 239 Miracle Mile in Coral Gables, transforming the former Edible Arrangements space. The concept combines yoga classes with frozen yogurt, specialty coffee, matcha, and Swedish pastries. An official opening date has not been announced beyond a September 2026 Instagram confirmation.

Cafe Rothem, a Korean-style bookstore café in Duluth, announced it will close on July 18 after 10 years in the neighborhood. The owners did not reveal a reason for the closure. A clearance sale on retail merchandise including books and CDs is being held ahead of closing.

data.location: 319 NE 167th St, North Miami Beach, FL 33162
data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Sterline Vil filed permit applications to open Double Take Market & Eatery at 319 N.E. 167th Street in North Miami Beach. The concept blends specialty grocery shopping with casual dining, celebrating Caribbean flavors including Haitian, Puerto Rican, Dominican, and American cuisine. An exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 1600 N Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
data.short_description: Pescatore Ristorante in West Palm Beach served its final meal on June 30 and has permanently closed. The family-friendly Italian restaurant was known for fresh seafood, artisan pizzas, and homemade breads. No official reason for the closure was provided in the announcement.

data.location: 1131 Uptown Park Blvd Ste 1, Houston, TX 77056
data.short_description: Uptown Sporting Club, a 5,000-square-foot sports and cocktail lounge, officially opens on July 4 at Uptown Park in Houston. The concept from restaurateurs Roveen Abante and Daniel Chang combines live sports viewing, upscale dining, handcrafted cocktails, and late-night entertainment. The venue will host watch parties for major sporting events throughout the year.

data.location: 3040 Rigel Ave., Suite 120, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.short_description: Nacho Daddy is opening its fourth Southern Nevada location and sixth overall at AREA15 (Zone 2), 3040 Rigel Avenue, Suite 120 in Las Vegas. The nearly 5,000-square-foot restaurant is the only Las Vegas-founded brand operating inside AREA15. It serves gourmet nachos, Mexican-inspired dishes, and specialty cocktails.

Pizza Guys opened a new location at 2794 W. Ball Road in Anaheim on June 18, expanding its footprint in Orange County. The Sacramento-based chain has grown to more than 100 locations and is known for freshly made dough and handcrafted pizzas. The locally owned and operated restaurant is run by Kevin Horbakht.

data.location: 231 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: The family-owned Filipino-Chinese bakery and restaurant Ling Nam is preparing to open a new location at 231 Grand Ave in South San Francisco. The expansion is led by second-generation owner Alexson Lim, continuing the legacy of founder Tony Lim. An opening date has not been announced.

A second new Ling Nam location is planned near the BART station in Union City, being opened by Alexson Lim and his wife. The Union City Express concept will serve the growing Filipino community in the area. An address and opening date have not been announced.

data.status: closing by the end of this month
data.short_description: Walnut Street Kitchen, a fine-dining Filipino-American restaurant in Montclair, will serve its final dinner on July 31. Owner and executive chef Beverly Lacsina cited industry challenges and difficult post-pandemic economic conditions as reasons for the closure. The restaurant opened in April 2022 near Montclair's Walnut Street Station.

Walnut St. Bagels & Co., the bakery and bagel shop operating next door to Walnut Street Kitchen at 98 Walnut Street, will also close at the end of July. The closure is tied to the same economic conditions cited by owner Beverly Lacsina. No separate announcement was made for the bagel shop.

San Babila Café opened its second Manhattan location on July 1 at 1247 Third Avenue on the Upper East Side. The Milan-inspired café serves specialty coffee, gelato, Italian pastries, and light fare throughout the day. The opening was celebrated with free gelato croissants for the first 200 guests.

Fanoos Grills is preparing to open its second San Francisco location at 411 Columbus Avenue in North Beach. The fast-casual Mediterranean concept received funding through the San Francisco Storefront Opportunity Grant Program. The restaurant will offer the same grab-and-go shawarma and Mediterranean favorites as its original Sutter Street location.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Properly Seasoned Kitchen, created by Chef Kyle Best, is among small businesses selected to receive funding through the San Francisco Storefront Opportunity Grant Program. The restaurant will serve Chef Kyle's signature "Pana Soul" cuisine blending Panamanian flavors, Southern comfort food, and French culinary techniques. Details about the opening date and location have not yet been announced.

data.location: 10620 Dean Martin Dr, Suite 100, Las Vegas, NV 89141
data.status: expected to open in the Southern Highlands...this fall
data.short_description: Hawthorne Craft Bar & Kitchen is set to open in the Southern Highlands within the KAKTUSlife plaza at 10620 Dean Martin Dr, Suite 100. The elevated sports bar concept was created by restaurateur Robert Parekh, who previously oversaw sports bar concepts on the Las Vegas Strip. The brand's website promises an elevated sports bar experience with innovative cocktails, craft beer, live entertainment, and mind-blowing audio visual enhancements.

data.location: 696 Randolph Ave Ste B, Costa Mesa, CA 92626
data.short_description: Ambitious Ales Brewing is expanding into Orange County with a new taproom at 696 Randolph Ave Ste B in Costa Mesa, marking its first venture outside of Long Beach. The brewery was founded in 2019 in Long Beach's Bixby Knolls neighborhood and is known for its rotating lineup of lagers, IPAs, saisons, and experimental brews. Additional details about the space and opening festivities have yet to be announced.

Amidulce, a mother-daughter bakery known for its modern take on traditional Mexican desserts, announced that a brick-and-mortar location is "coming soon" at 202 Folsom St in downtown San Francisco. The bakery received support through the City of San Francisco's Storefront Opportunity Grant Program. While the company confirmed the forthcoming location on its website, an exact opening date has not been disclosed.

data.location: 1731 W. Katella Ave., Suite F, Anaheim, CA 92804
data.short_description: Sushi Kani is slated to debut at 1731 W. Katella Ave., Suite F in Anaheim, taking over the former home of Rent-A-Center. The restaurant will specialize in fresh sushi, specialty rolls, and high-quality sashimi, operating daily from 5:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. to focus on the evening and late-night crowd.

data.status: slated to open in early September 2026
data.short_description: Sergeant Ma, from Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group, is slated to open in early September 2026 at 185 Berry Street in San Francisco's China Basin neighborhood, across from Oracle Park overlooking Mission Creek. The restaurant will showcase California cuisine rooted in Asian tradition, led by Executive Chef and Partner Jason Halverson. The space will feature expansive indoor and outdoor dining, floor-to-ceiling windows, private dining rooms, and waterfront fire pits.

Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group will also operate Waters Edge, an adjacent daytime café and community workspace at the same 185 Berry Street location. The café will serve coffee, breakfast, and casual lunch fare. No separate opening date is specified for Waters Edge beyond the broader Sergeant Ma development context.

data.location: 204 S Decatur Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89107
data.short_description: Dollar Tree is expected to open a new location at Decatur Crossing at 204 S Decatur Blvd in West Las Vegas, based on a City of Las Vegas permit. The brand has already begun the hiring process for the new store. No exact opening date has been confirmed.

Fiore del Vino, a women-owned wine window inspired by the historic buchette del vino of Florence, is set to open in September at 1121 L Street, Suite 101 in downtown Sacramento. The concept will serve European and local wines, beers, and artisan small bites through a walk-up window with a spacious patio. It is co-owned by Suzanne Ricci, Melea Martinez, and Sheena Takher.

data.status: slated to wrap up by November of next year
data.short_description: Flower Child is expected to open at 14611 Mason Road, Suite 85A in the Dunham Pointe development in Cypress, with construction planned for a May 2027 start and completion by November 2027. The health-focused fast-casual concept offers gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan items for lunch and dinner. This will be the fifth Greater Houston region Flower Child location.

data.location: 12515 Northlake Blvd, Suite 110, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33412
data.short_description: Carmela Coffee is planning a new café at Avenir Town Center at 12515 Northlake Boulevard, Suite 110 in Palm Beach Gardens, listed as "coming soon" on both the Avenir Town Center and Carmela Coffee websites. Founded in 2018, Carmela Coffee sources beans from a family-owned farm in Costa Rica and roasts them in Florida. The Avenir shop will become one of 17 Carmela Coffee locations either open or in development across Florida and New York.

data.location: 18318 E. Chandler Heights Rd., Suite 102, Gilbert, AZ 85298
data.status: Construction is expected to take about six months before the new cafe is ready to open
data.short_description: Charlee Rose Coffee is expanding in Gilbert with a second location at 18318 E. Chandler Heights Rd., Suite 102, after owners Brandy and Brianna Grice signed the lease. Construction is expected to take about six months. The family-owned business was founded as a mobile coffee trailer before becoming a brick-and-mortar café at its original Gilbert location at 522 N. Gilbert Rd., Suite 102.

data.location: 5920 Coral Ridge Dr, Coral Springs, FL 33321
data.status: expected to open the end of July 2026
data.short_description: Ember & Vine, an all-day dining concept by P Hospitality Management created by restaurateurs Eddie and Christina Pozzuoli, will open at 5920 Coral Ridge Drive in Coral Springs' Sawgrass Center. The restaurant will serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily with seasonal ingredients, house-made preparations, and globally inspired flavors. It is P Hospitality Management's third Broward County restaurant.

data.status: opening is currently targeted for Q4 2026
data.short_description: A new Jersey Mike's Subs is targeted to open at 10031 Marsh Lane, Suite 230 within Hopkins Marsh Lane Plaza in Dallas, with franchisee Mark Melendez confirming a Q4 2026 target. Construction bids are still pending and a more precise timeline is expected within the coming weeks. Melendez currently operates Jersey Mike's locations in McKinney and Allen.

data.status: slated to be customer-ready early next year
data.short_description: Dave & Buster's is taking over the space vacated by H&M at Annapolis Mall, 2002 Annapolis Mall Road, and is slated to be customer-ready early next year (2027). The concept will offer a full-service restaurant, extensive video arcade, and multi-screen sports bar. No precise grand opening date has been announced.

data.status: reopened on June 27 after closing in May
data.short_description: PJ's Daily Grind reopened at 1619 Coalton Road in Superior, Colorado on June 27 following a rebrand from its former name PJ Foods. The locally owned café specializes in handcrafted coffee, scratch-made pastries, and breakfast offerings. The business recently held a soft opening after the rebrand.

Kingdom Sushi is preparing to open its first location in Winter Garden at 9240 Miley Dr, conveniently located near Hamlin Town Center and the Horizon West community. The chain, founded in Orlando in 2019, now has nine locations across Florida and offers an all-you-can-eat menu featuring sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, and appetizers. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: temporarily close during the renovation, with plans to reopen next year
data.short_description: Maison Dupuy Hotel, a 200-room historic French Quarter property, was acquired by the Valentino family and is undergoing a $13 million renovation with plans to reopen in 2027 as part of Hilton's Curio Collection. The renovation will include upgraded guest rooms and public spaces, new furniture and fixtures, improvements to the restaurant and mechanical systems, and a new restaurant concept. The hotel will temporarily close during the renovation.

data.location: The Yard at Harvest, Woodinville, WA (Address not specified)
data.status: expected to open in late spring or early summer 2027
data.short_description: Chef Hari Nayak is bringing a new, as-yet-unnamed Indian restaurant concept to The Yard at Harvest in Woodinville, his first Seattle-area restaurant. The concept will feature dishes from across India with a focus on charcoal grilling and tandoor cooking, along with a beverage program centered on cocktails and Pacific Northwest wines. The restaurant's name has not yet been announced.

data.status: expected to open in early fall 2026

The owners previously opened the Italian restaurant Carolina on Dundas West in 2024.
